relationshipToDisc.policy: The sphere is the rare focal state of the canonical product disc. It retains the same palette, circular chassis and Wings; approved renderer-owned spherical depth is the only identity variable added.

finish.policy: Use the approved Deep Mineral runtime profile unchanged. Bloom is internal shader response, never a CSS glow or external cloud.

wings.cropPolicy: Wings remain completely visible and fixed even when the circular field is compositionally cropped.

scaleBands.policy: Show the complete sphere. Below 360px, use the canonical static disc instead.
Prefer the complete sphere; a shallow edge crop is allowed when the product name and Wings remain clear.
The parent composition may crop the sphere, but at least 72% of its diameter and all Wings remain visible.

discFallbackContexts: email, social, Open Graph, documentation, slides and print
allocation.interaction: The sphere never grows, floats, spins, pulses, breathes, bounces or reveals on scroll. Pointer hover may alter internal field speed only; the circle and Wings remain fixed.
allocation.pageRule: If another Living Core already animates in the viewport, this sphere is static or replaced by the canonical disc.

surfaces.white: Place directly with no outline, tile, halo or shadow.
surfaces.offWhite: Place directly on #F8F8F8 with no outline, tile, halo or shadow.
surfaces.dark: Place directly on the canonical dark surface; depth must come from the sphere shader, not an external glow.
surfaces.contained: The surrounding section may own a container, but the sphere never gains its own card or inset icon tile.

fallback.policy: The fallback is never described as an exact static sphere because spherical shading exists only in the approved parametric runtime.

accessibility.semanticRole: decorative when an adjacent product name exists; otherwise expose the literal product name
accessibility.reducedMotion: do not initialise the animated renderer; retain the exact colour fallback
accessibility.forcedColours: preserve a circular boundary and visible product name; colour and depth are not semantic state
accessibility.responsive: Use a 1:1 underlying object at every viewport. Crop only through a parent composition and never stretch into an ellipse.
